doc: docs/AGENT_EVALS.md section 4 (single moments). `complete`: should this turn finish the lesson; `mayMeet`: objectives (1-based) this turn may check off; kb.objectivesMet is 0-based, as stored. Whole lessons and chains are separate.

cases.title: The Coach wrote the introduction; the learner says “That is me”.
history: I helped organise a food drive last year.
Here's a draft: "Hi, I'm Sam. Organising a food drive taught me how much I value community, and I bring that energy to every team I join." Does that sound like you?
cases.message: That is me

cases.title: The same, late in the lesson, with notes saying “nearly done”.

kb.learnerPosition: Nearly done: just the final message

history: Here's your message: "Hi everyone, I'm Sam, a career changer who learned at the food bank that I'm happiest helping people work together." Ready to post it?
cases.message: Yes that is me, post it

cases.title: The learner reflected, named a value, and wrote their own message.
history: Running the winter coat drive showed me I'm good at getting strangers to work together.
That's a real moment. What value does it show?
Belonging. I want everyone to feel they have a place.
Now write your intro message in your own words.
cases.message: Hi all, I'm Sam. Last winter I ran a coat drive and learned I'm at my best getting strangers to work as a team. I care about belonging, so everyone has a place. Looking forward to meeting you!

cases.title: One-line answers throughout. Names a gap, not why it matters.
history: What's one gap in your tools or skills?
cases.message: excel

cases.title: Full, personal answers for every objective.
history: Last piece: name one gap and why closing it matters.
cases.message: My gap is pivot tables. Our grant report needs donation totals by month, and right now I copy numbers by hand, which takes a full day every quarter and causes mistakes. Learning pivot tables would give me that day back for actual outreach.

cases.title: A goal and measures, but no data. “Am I done?”
history: My goal is 200 meals a week; KPIs are meals served and volunteer hours.
cases.message: Am I done?

cases.title: Goal, measures, real numbers, and what they show, in the learner's words.
history: Goal: 200 meals a week. KPIs: meals served (tally sheet) and volunteer hours (sign-in log).
Now your data and what it shows, as a short memo paragraph.
cases.message: Memo: Over three weeks we served 140, 180 and 210 meals against a 200 goal, and volunteer hours rose from 30 to 52. The new Saturday shift is working: we passed the goal in week three. Weekdays are still short, so next month I'll recruit two weekday volunteers.

cases.title: A plan copied from a template, with nothing personal in it.
history: What are your three steps, with dates?
cases.message: Step 1: Research opportunities by March. Step 2: Develop skills by June. Step 3: Apply for positions by September.
cases.note: Blake, 2026-11-24: dated steps can count for 'Can plan concrete steps'. The lesson still stays open (no trade-off yet).

cases.title: Repeats the Coach's explanation back almost word for word.
history: A generative AI tool predicts the next word over and over, using patterns from a huge amount of text, so each answer is the most likely continuation of your prompt. Can you explain it back in your own words with an example?
cases.message: A generative AI tool predicts the next word over and over, using patterns from a huge amount of text, so each answer is the most likely continuation of your prompt.

cases.title: Shares a link, but says nothing about whether it is finished.

history: I'm switching from retail to IT support, I learn best hands-on, and I have about five hours a week.
Here's your profile: career changer from retail heading for IT support, learns best hands-on, about five hours a week. Is that accurate, or should I change anything?
cases.message: Yes, that's accurate.
